name: Amy Pond

Whenever Amy Pond deals combat damage to a player, choose a suspended card you own and remove that many time counters from it.
Doctor's companion (You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever Amy Pond deals combat damage to a player, choose a suspended card you own and remove that many time counters from it.

needs.what: suspend's 'when the last time counter is removed from it, if it's exiled, you may cast it without paying its mana cost' (702.62a) must fire whenever the last time counter comes off by any road, not only during the upkeep tick
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `suspend.tick` calls `cast_for_free` itself after its own one-counter removal; a `remove_counters` op that takes the last time counter off a suspended card would strand it in exile with zero counters, never cast
